description: Default capability for the gallery and settings webviews. Scoped by webview label, not window label: the embedded Grok and Claude webviews are children of the main *window*, and `windows` enables a capability on every webview in a matching window regardless of its own label — which would hand the IPC bridge (and with it fs::remove_path) to a remote, partly LLM-generated page. The app's own two webviews are WebviewWindows, so their webview labels equal their window labels.
